name: Iogi Chika
source: Chika is a third-year student and [url=/c35458]Iori's[/url] bodyguard. Despite her cold and aloof personality, Chika is actually very girlish, and is good at sewing. She loves cooking as well, but is incredibly bad at it to the point where Iori calls her curry "honey soup" because of its extreme sweetness.
